# #134 - Arvid Lindqvist: så kan en inbromsning i AI-rallyt skapa en fastighetsrevansch

**Feed**: montrosepodden  
**Published**: 2026-09-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Arvid Lindqvist, who manages Catella's systematic real estate funds at FCG Fonder, argues that Swedish listed property is widely mispriced. Premium-valued warehouse and light-industrial names such as Sagax, NP3 and Emilshus look expensive relative to their required returns. Heavily discounted office and other out-of-favour segments offer high cash-flow yields and room to re-rate. He sees a strong economy, very tight credit spreads, a near-record transaction market and likely US financial repression, all of which favour real assets like property. A slowdown in AI capex could also ease pressure on long-term interest rates and soften the overly negative view of offices.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SAGA-B — Sagax | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Premium-valued light-industrial landlord. Growth is harder at its size, and slowing growth may expose vacancies. The guest's model favours discounted names over premium ones.

#### Reasoning

The guest's (fund manager's) model looks for high forward cash-flow yield relative to the required return. He says premium names in the popular warehouse/light-industrial segment show low yield relative to risk and have relied on issuing equity to buy cash flows. Sagax has already developed weakly: a premium needs growth, which gets harder with size, and when the growth story ends the underlying vacancy shows. There is no explicit sell call, so this is inferred and weak.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Sagax shows sustained organic growth without vacancy increases
- if the premium valuation compresses to fair value vs its required return
- if sector inflows return and support premium issuers

> *"Sen ska man komma ihåg till exempel med Sagax, de har ju haft en ganska svag utveckling för att där, de har blivit väldigt stora och när du har en premievärdering, då vill det sig till att du faktiskt kan visa upp tillväxt också."*
